mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CIRCLE ( CIRCLE_ID, USER_ID, CIRCLE_NAME, CIRCLE_CATEGORY, CIRCLE_DATE, CIRCLE_MAXMEMBER, CIRCLE_MEMBER, CIRCLE_DETAIL, CIRCLE_ADDRESS, CIRCLE_LAT, CIRCLE_LNG, CIRCLE_PLACE_ID, PICTURE_ID, PICTURE_URL ) VALUES ( Circle_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{circleName}, #{circleCategory}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{circleDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{circleMaxMember}, #{circleMember}, #{circleDetail}, #{circleAddress}, #{circleLat}, #{circleLng}, #{circlePlaceId}, #{pictureId}, #{pictureUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CIRCLE ORDER BY CIRCLE_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CIRCLE SET CIRCLE_MEMBER = CIRCLE_MEMBER + 1 WHERE CIRCLE_ID = #{circleId} AND CIRCLE_MEMBER < CIRCLE_MAXMEMBER

UPDATE circle SET circle_name = #{circleName}, circle_category = #{circleCategory}, circle_date = #{circleDate}, circle_maxmember = #{circleMaxMember}, circle_detail = #{circleDetail}, circle_address = #{circleAddress}, circle_lat = #{circleLat}, circle_lng = #{circleLng}, circle_place_id = #{circlePlaceId}, picture_url = #{pictureUrl} WHERE circle_id = #{circleId}
